scripts.build: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli packages/server && npm run bundle && npm run build -w @specage/web
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli packages/server && tsc --noEmit -p packages/web
scripts.test: tsc -b packages/core packages/cli packages/server && vitest run
scripts.e2e:visual: npm run build -w @specage/web && playwright test -c packages/web/visual/playwright.config.ts
scripts.e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c packages/web/playwright.config.ts
scripts.bundle: esbuild packages/cli/src/bin.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node22 --outfile=packages/cli/bundle/specage.js --banner:js="import {createRequire as __cr} from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
